r: apol is a graphical tool that allows the user to inspect and analyze aspects of an SELinux policy.

A single file containing a binary policy. This file is usually named by version on Linux systems, for example, policy.30. This file is usually named sepolicy on Android systems. If not provided, apol will start with none loaded.

<dl><dt data-o="">-h, --help</dt><dd>Print help information and exit.</dd><dt data-o="">--version</dt><dd>Print version information and exit.</dd><dt data-o="">-v, --verbose</dt><dd>Print additional informational messages.</dd><dt data-o="">--debug</dt><dd>Enable debugging output.</dd></dl>
Please report bugs via the SETools bug tracker, https://github.com/SELinuxProject/setools/issues
